findings.evidence: WeightL2Isometry.lean:50 `variable {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (w : α → ℝ)`; new file uses only measure-space-general API (integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul₀, L2.inner_def, HilbertBasis.mkOfOrthogonalEqBot, mapₗᵢ) with no ℝ-specific fact on the domain.
findings.fix: State the file over `variable {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]` with `f : ℕ → α → ℝ`, `w : α → ℝ`, `μ : Measure α`; downstream polynomial families (Hermite/Chebyshev) instantiate α := ℝ. The docstring already advertises this as family-agnostic / 'any orthogonal system of real-valued functions', so the ℝ domain contradicts the intended level.
findings.issue: Under-generalization of the domain to ℝ. All declarations (barePolyLp, integral_mul_withDensity, integral_barePoly_real, inner_barePolyLp, orthonormal_barePolyLp, hilbertBasisOfWeightedMeasure, hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem) take μ : Measure ℝ, w : ℝ → ℝ, f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ, but the reals appear only in the codomain of f/w; the domain ℝ is never used. The only nontrivial dependency, weightL2Isometry, is itself stated over {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (w : α → ℝ) (WeightL2Isometry.lean:50), so there is no obstruction.

summary: The construction fixes the domain to ℝ (μ : Measure ℝ, w : ℝ → ℝ, f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ), but nothing in the file uses that the domain is ℝ, and its own dependency weightL2Isometry is already stated over an arbitrary measurable space. Generalize the domain to a general measure space.
